answer: Call it a persistent fee rebate system: each task carries a 5-credit fee, refunded only after three distinct confirmations within 24 hours, and a fresh identity waits ten tasks before any refund. The terrace queue displays pending confirmations so buyers can see delayed identities. The atlas index flags repeated counterparties, blocking circular confirmations. An onyx receipt binds each confirmation to the payer; an attacker cloning N agents pays 50N credits upfront and absorbs N delays before earning a rebate.
